name: Karuizawa (Japan)
description: An orange field with a blue band along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the Karuizawa town emblem: a blue stylised bird with outstretched wings.
history: Municipal flag of Karuizawa, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 22 December 1960.

features.role: Karuizawa town emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched wings
